title: Louis J Walsh
html_source:
Louis Joseph Walsh (1880 – 1942):
Lawyer and writer
Louis Walsh was born in Maghera, County Londonderry. He was a solicitor in Ballycastle, County Antrim, and in County Londonderry and later a District Justice in County Donegal.
Dictionary of Ulster Biography

His books are considered minor works.
